services.name: Theatre Rentals
services.desc: Indulge your senses and explore everything St. Jacobs Country and Waterloo Region have to offer. Located in the heart of the Market District, bordering the city of Waterloo, the St. Jacobs Country Playhouse is a source of tremendous pride for the community. Operating year-round, this venue features turn-of-the-century masonry and heavy timber character associated with traditional Mennonite architecture. The outdoor courtyard is a tranquil place to gather before the show or during intermission.
